name: Wand of Slumber

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Seven charges (1d6 + 1 back at dawn): Sleep (DC 15) for one, Catnap for three.
text: This wand has 7 charges and regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges each dawn; when you spend the last one, roll a d20 and on a 1 the wand crumbles. While holding it you can spend 1 charge to cast Sleep (save DC 15) or 3 charges to cast Catnap.
